subject: Run integration tests in parallel (reduces runtime from ~12 minutes to ~95 seconds) (#1355)
reason: The change modifies only valkey-search's own build and test infrastructure: build.sh and scripts/common.rc gain a --parallel flag and dependency checks; integration/ and testing/integration/ gain pytest-xdist support, per-worker port/log/tmpdir isolation, and hardened setup/teardown cleanup in the test harness. No source file compiled into the libsearch module is touched, so the module binary and every command, reply, indexing, replication and persistence path are byte-for-byte the same behaviour at the change and its parent.
